links.outcome: Accuracy of citations and answers in ChatGPT drug information responses
links.effect: ChatGPT scored 21 of 44 points (47.73%) overall; drug information enhanced prompt 33% and patient case 20%; generated misleading or fictional answers and citations.
links.quote: ChatGPT scored higher in calculation and multiple-choice questions but scored lower in drug information and patient case questions, generating misleading or fictional answers and citations.

links.outcome: ChatGPT clinical knowledge accuracy on pharmacy patient case and drug information questions
links.effect: Overall score 21/44 (47.73%); patient case category scored 20%, enhanced prompt drug information 33%, while calculations 100%.
links.quote: ChatGPT scored higher in pharmacy calculation (100%), drug information (83%), and top 200 drugs (80%) categories and lower in drug information enhanced prompt (33%) and patient case (20%) categories.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT (v3.5) answering clinical pharmacy questions (vignettes/case questions and drug information) evaluated for appropriateness and accuracy.
